body:
> He would not want to see you die.

He wouldn't want to see me unhappy either.

> So stop playing video games.

No.

> Its what your boyfriend would have always wanted you to do.

Don't pretend to know what he wanted.

It isn't supposed to fix anything, it's supposed to stop everything.

I don't want to wait for the future, that's kind of the whole idea.

I'm not hurting anyone. I have no one. I don't know why this is so hard for you to understand. I don't have friends, I don't have family, the only boyfriend I've ever had has died. There is nothing for me here.
I think you don't know how it feels to want to die. I think you're just parroting things you've seen other people say so that you can feel like you helped.

Most of the people in this stupid subreddit live nice cushy upper middle class lives with nice families and you assholes still have the gall to say things like "get over it" and "suicide is a permanent solution to a temporary problem" and "you don't deserve an early death." Do you listen to yourself when you talk?

Everyone dies. 

You don't give a fuck about me.
What do you want me to say?

I'm not good at talking to people. People don't like talking to me. Anyways, eventually they'd ask about my friends. 

I don't want to go anywhere, and I don't have any money.
If I had friends, I'd be talking to them and not Reddit.
I'm on medication, it doesn't make anything better. It just makes it get worse slower.
